Jacob Doft decreased its stake in Liberty Global Plc (LBTYK) by 2.64% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The hedge fund run by Jacob Doft held 5.35 million shares of the television services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $181.06M, down from 5.50 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Highline Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Liberty Global Plc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $22.71 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.25% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $28.23. About 3.00M shares traded. Liberty Global plc (NASDAQ:LBTYK) has declined 10.09% since May 24, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.64% the S&P500.
Honeywell International Inc increased its stake in Visa Inc (V) by 59% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. It has outperformed by 20.43% the S&P500.

It also increased its holding in Fedex Corp (NYSE:FDX) by 150,000 shares in the quarter, for a total of 309,000 shares, and has risen its stake in British Amern Tob Plc (NYSEMKT:BTI).
